description: Start an AWS SSO login via the device-code flow (no browser spawned from this process). Returns a verification URL and short code -- surface these to the user so they can open the URL in their own browser and paste the code. After they auth, call aws_login_complete with the returned sessionId to confirm completion. For a user with NO profile yet, pass ssoSession plus startUrl and ssoRegion instead of profile: this writes a managed [sso-session] block to the AWS config file (never touching one the user wrote) and logs in to IAM Identity Center directly; then use aws_sso_list_assignments and aws_sso_generate_profiles.

profile.description: AWS profile configured for SSO. Defaults to $AWS_PROFILE or 'default'. Mutually exclusive with ssoSession.

ssoRegion.description: Region of the Identity Center instance, e.g. us-east-1. Only with ssoSession.

ssoSession.description: Log in to an IAM Identity Center sso-session directly, without any profile. Use with startUrl + ssoRegion to create the [sso-session] block on first use; omit them to log in to an existing block.

startUrl.description: Identity Center start URL (https://...). Only with ssoSession.

name: aws_login_start
